task_manifest.task_hash_encoding: freeze.sha over canonical pinned task object
task_manifest.notes: End-to-end (doc §11.1) prospective_fixed_benchmark task list for the J(P)/J(C)/ΔJ estimand under the v4 identity. A FIXED, KNOWN benchmark: inference conditions on this exact task set using NEW independent starts resampled by start; it does NOT claim unseen-family generalization (operator_attests_unseen stays false) and the exposure ledger is bound at freeze. Selected outcome-blind from the verified roaming-protectable pool by structural complexity only.
task_manifest.selection_rule: complexity-stratified across fault-token count with per-stratum quota {2:1,3:2,4:2,5:2,6:1}=8; within stratum rank by (persona difficulty DESC, tasks_json_index ASC); structural attributes only, no model outcomes consulted

additional_exposures.basis: metadata-only aggregation of run_manifest.json + status.json + dev manifests; no model calls, no outcome labels

categories.metadata_screening: task entered a manifest via exhaustive metadata-only scan
categories.answers_read_for_design: reference-solution structure inspected during manifest construction (design use, not outcome observation)
categories.real_development_runs: task actually executed live with real models; outcomes observed
categories.offline_scripted_runs: task executed only under scripted mock fixture (no real model exposure)
categories.pre_registered_only: present in a manifest/config but never executed live

caveats.description: A heldout confirmatory candidate (idx37) shares one lexical fault token with a development refuel task, but does not satisfy the modern code containment or Jaccard>=0.5 neighbour-exclusion condition. Under the v4 prospective_fixed_benchmark route this is disclosed rather than treated as a heldout violation; the strict v3 heldout neighbour-exclusion remains a separate rule and is not deleted to let an old config masquerade as confirmatory.
caveats.resolution: disclose_in_report; do not conflate intra-sample token-disjointness with dev/confirm neighbour exclusion

payload.family_exclusion_rule: prospective_fixed_benchmark: fixed known benchmark task list; inference conditions on this set with NEW independent starts resampled by start (root/shared-prefix/arm dependencies preserved); family/cluster structure reported, not required disjoint; exposure ledger bound; v4
